lonar_crater.name: Lonar Crater (Earth) - SRTM Radial Transect
lonar_crater.source: NASA SRTM (Shuttle Radar Topography Mission) 30m Global DEM
lonar_crater.description: Trans-crater topographic section showing outer ejecta flank, elevated crater rim crest (562m), steep inner crater wall descending to endorheic soda lake floor (478m), and opposite rim.

tso_kar.name: Tso Kar Basin (Earth) - Periglacial Valley Transect
tso_kar.description: Cross-valley section of the high-altitude Ladakh Changthang plateau showing surrounding periglacial ridges dropping down into the flat hypersaline playa and lake basin at 4530m.

sambhar_lake.name: Sambhar Salt Lake (Earth) - Playa Flat Transect
sambhar_lake.description: Planar cross-section illustrating extreme low relief and flatness (< 2m vertical gradient across 10 km) characteristic of endorheic evaporite salt pans.

lunar_south_pole_shackleton.name: Shackleton Crater (Moon) - LOLA Radial Profile
lunar_south_pole_shackleton.source: NASA LOLA (Lunar Orbiter Laser Altimeter) Polar 20m/px DEM
lunar_south_pole_shackleton.description: LOLA laser altimetry transect showing the rim crest (+1250m relative to datum), dramatic 30-degree inner walls plunging 4.2 km into permanent darkness (PSR floor at -2950m), and opposite crest.

mars_jezero_delta.name: Jezero Delta Front (Mars) - MOLA / HiRISE DTM Profile
mars_jezero_delta.source: NASA MOLA MEGDR & HiRISE DTM (Mars 2020 Landing Site)
mars_jezero_delta.description: Topographic profile showing Perseverance rover traverse across flat basaltic floor (-2530m) approaching and ascending the steep 65m erosional delta front scarp onto the delta topset.
